sources.name: Overture Maps Places
sources.role: Primary statewide consumer destination search source
sources.coverage: Global; filter to Texas and all 254 Texas counties
sources.recordCountEvidence: Overture documentation described roughly 75 million total place records, with primary contributions from Meta plus Microsoft, Foursquare, PinMeTo, AllThePlaces, BrightQuery, DAC, Krick, RenderSEO, and others.
sources.updateFrequency: Monthly releases; public distribution retains two monthly releases for about 60 days.
sources.license: Places theme under CDLA Permissive 2.0 / permissive open licensing, with source attribution requirements documented by Overture.
sources.accuracy: Point places with names, categories, brand/address fields and confidence/source signals; not sufficient alone for sensitive public-safety or critical-infrastructure authority.
sources.consumerSuitability: High for search, favorites, routing seed candidates, and general awareness when county containment and quality gates pass.

sources.name: Foursquare OS Places
sources.role: Open enrichment/comparison source for missing POIs, aliases, and brand/category cross-checks
sources.recordCountEvidence: Foursquare OS Places marketplace/documentation describes over 100 million unique/commercial POI records.
sources.updateFrequency: Monthly ecosystem snapshots are documented by marketplace/sample-data hosts; release freshness must be captured per ingest.
sources.license: Apache 2.0 with Foursquare NOTICE/attribution preservation requirements.
sources.accuracy: Strong POI breadth; must be de-duplicated against Overture/GERS and government authority sources before consumer exposure.
sources.consumerSuitability: Useful as an enrichment source, not sole authority, until Texas completeness, closure handling, and category taxonomy mapping are audited.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap POIs
sources.role: Community corroboration and rural gap discovery source; not merged into proprietary destination database without ODbL governance
sources.coverage: Global volunteer map data; filter to Texas
sources.recordCountEvidence: No stable statewide Texas POI count selected in LP159 because OSM completeness varies by community and tag family.
sources.updateFrequency: Continuous community editing; ingest cadence should be monthly snapshots if used.
sources.license: ODbL 1.0; commercial use allowed, but attribution and share-alike obligations can apply to adapted databases.
sources.accuracy: Variable POI completeness; often strong for public/civic and recreation features, weaker for exhaustive commercial chains in rural areas.
sources.consumerSuitability: Consumer-useful as corroboration or separately attributed ODbL layer; not approved as the primary blended source without legal design review.

sources.name: Texas Government Open Data, TNRIS/TxGIO, TxDOT, and TWDB GIS
sources.role: Authoritative Texas supplement for government, transportation, natural recreation, water, dams, boundaries, and route-context datasets
sources.coverage: Statewide Texas datasets where published by agency; individual layers vary by agency and dataset
sources.recordCountEvidence: Layer-specific counts must be recorded at ingest; LP159 approves source families, not uncounted bulk deployment.
sources.updateFrequency: Agency/layer-specific; capture publication date, last-modified date, and refresh interval per layer.
sources.license: Public/open government data subject to portal or agency terms; preserve attribution and disclaimers.
sources.accuracy: Highest authority for government-owned transportation, water, and civic/natural assets when maintained by the responsible agency.
sources.consumerSuitability: High for authoritative supplements; not comprehensive for retail/fuel/medical chains.

sources.name: Federal HIFLD successor/provider portals and EPA Facility Registry Service
sources.role: Authoritative supplement for public safety, hospitals, emergency response structures, power plants, regulated facilities, ports/refineries, and critical infrastructure context
sources.recordCountEvidence: HIFLD/data-provider portals list hundreds of infrastructure layers; EPA FRS publishes facility datasets such as power plants with checked/updated dates in Data.gov.
sources.updateFrequency: Provider-specific; EPA FRS datasets may update frequently, while archived HIFLD layers must not be treated as live authority.
sources.license: Federal public data/public-domain where marked; verify each layer because HIFLD Secure/commercial/FOUO content is not open.
sources.accuracy: Strong for emergency-management and regulated-facility context; potentially sensitive and must be bounded to consumer-safe awareness wording.
sources.consumerSuitability: Suitable for awareness and notification context after sensitivity screening; not for unrestricted destination marketing/search until reviewed.

sources.name: Google Places API
sources.role: Runtime lookup only; rejected as long-term stored statewide registry source
sources.recordCountEvidence: No redistributable statewide Texas record count selected for Gridly storage.
sources.license: Terms restrict use with non-Google maps and limit caching of latitude/longitude values from Places API to 30 days; not compatible with durable offline statewide registry storage.
sources.accuracy: High consumer freshness but contractually unsuitable for Gridly's governed stored destination registry strategy.
sources.consumerSuitability: Rejected for LP159 registry storage, offline use, redistribution, and non-Google-map integration constraints.

sources.name: SafeGraph Places / Geometry
sources.role: Paid commercial fallback for brand completeness, closure history, and building/geometry precision if contract terms permit Gridly uses
sources.coverage: Global/US commercial POI product; filter to Texas
sources.recordCountEvidence: SafeGraph product material describes 80 million-plus POIs and monthly updates with attributes such as brand, address, lat/long, hours, closure/open history, and building footprints.
sources.license: Commercial contract required; approve only if storage, search, routing, offline use, consumer notifications, and redistribution/display rights are explicit.
sources.accuracy: Strong for commercial brand POIs and geometry; government/public safety authority still requires official sources.
sources.consumerSuitability: Potentially high if licensed; not selected as primary because legal/economic terms are not evidenced in-repo.
